scope: Independent read-only raw artifact and journal audit; no builds, QEMU invocations, Git operations, implementation edits, or root oracle imports
command: PowerShell here-string piped to python -X utf8 -
limitations: Audit reread preserved local evidence; it did not independently witness the past process kill or rerun QEMU. The actual harness exit and child-live/kill records are preserved and cross-checked.

Raw serial has aggregate observer PASS and UNKNOWN markers, not a complete per-IPC ACK or per-publication event trace. No-ACK and no-retry assurances additionally depend on compiled observer assertions and the real counterexamples.
Three counterexamples mutate actual guest behavior. Three mutate observer counters only and do not prove real extra device I/O or an undelivered IPC.

The two historical old-observer mutation source snapshots are not retained individually; old source hashes were not independently rebuilt. New six mutant hashes were independently reconstructed from the frozen main source and static mutation definitions.
M1-M5 broader regressions are managed by parent; this report audits only M6a gate including its one M1 baseline plus eight counterexamples.
No physical power loss, hardware DMA/IOMMU, production safety, human audit, or app routing fix is established by this evidence.
not_executed: No physical-device, firmware, NAS or production data operation
harness_review: Captured stdout/stderr originate from subprocess pipes, with raw bytes written unchanged.
External crash kill uses the owned Popen process handle and distinct Windows termination code; records actual child returncode, running state and exact marker after live hold.
Recovery guard validates previous accepted non-recovery stage, same resolved image path, identity, actual prior after-image hash and full bytes.
Exact case feature and frozen source are compared with the immutable run manifest before invoking QEMU.
